notes: Build variety pass. Asking for a 'budget' build used to hand back the same Primed-loaded build as every other ask — qualifiers are now real: budget (no Primed mods), beginner, status and crit asks each get a build that actually matches, built from verified library builds with base-equivalent swaps (Primed Point Blank becomes Point Blank) that are named in the answer. Generated Warframe builds now follow each frame's own kit — Saryn gets a spore-and-range caster core with her augment, Wisp a support core, Rhino a tank core — instead of one shared skeleton. Every build answer also lists the other verified builds for that item, and build cards can no longer render with an empty mod list.
